newsitem.title: UK: Insurers to focus on alliances at Asian conference.
newsitem.headline: Insurers to focus on alliances at Asian conference.

text.p: The creation of strategic alliances will provide a focus for next week's 18th Conference of the East Asian Insurance Congress in Singapore, a leading broker said.
David Brewer, chairman of broking group Sedgwick China and Sedgwick Japan, told Reuters that partnerships are key to making a success in the region.

"There is certainly something in having a partner to hold your hand in an unfamiliar market," he said, adding that in many countries in Asia, such as Malaysia, setting up a partnerhip with a local company is the only way to get a foothold.
A record 1,500 insurance industry executives from around the world will gather at the conference to discuss the booming Asian market.
The conference runs from October 6 to October 11 and is the biggest ever, underlining the growing importance of Singapore as South East Asia's main insurance and reinsurance centre.
Over 40 international reinsurers now have an underwriting presence in Singapore. The latest arrival is Bermuda-based Mid Ocean Re, which had its underwriting license granted on October 2.
Other recent licence applicants include Kemper Re, Yasuda Re, CNA Re, Everest Re and MMI Australia. Zurich Re and AGF have both upgraded representative offices to branch underwriting operations.
The theme of the conference is "Towards a More Professional and Efficient Insurance Industry in a Rapidly Changing Environment".

Topics on the conference agenda include greater liberalisation of financial services in East Asia, the impact of mega insurerers and reinsurers on the region and how information technology can be applied to the region's insurance market.
